subject: hm-image-geometry
description: image-sdk's geometry (docs/formats/hm-image-plan.md): input.operation names a function and the other fields are its arguments, with null for a missing ratio; expected is its result, exactly, or within the case's tolerance where it states one. Sizes, crops and points are in pixels of the oriented source or of the composition. Results are rounded as JavaScript's Math.round does, halves toward positive infinity. Generated cases come from fixed-seed generators.
